title: Brake feel, grabbing, and parking brake operation
summary: Feedback on brakes centers on complaints about poor feel, grabbing, hardness, and rough operation, while many sampled mentions are service-style descriptions or operational notes with unclear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention acceptable brake behavior or parking brake functionality, but the examples are sparse and partly procedural rather than strongly favorable.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor brake quality, grabby or unsmooth pedal response, and difficulty modulating braking.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include ambiguous statements about brakes operating fine, hard or rough braking feel, parking brake instructions, and sudden braking events without enough context to classify sentiment reliably.

signal_notes.interpretation: The exploratory signal indicates ICE examples in this topic are more often labeled negative or mixed than the non-ICE examples within this dataset slice.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the observable sentiment pattern is based on limited clearly classified examples.
Several examples are service-writer notes or operational explanations about the parking brake rather than direct evaluations of brake quality.
The topic mixes driving feel complaints with parking brake operation and automated braking references, so it is not a fully uniform issue cluster.
